demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Domestic Home Textile industry demand described as building momentum, driven by organized retail growth, rising urbanization and post-pandemic recovery in consumer spending.
- GST-driven reduction in cheap imports is described as benefiting organized players such as the company.
- Premium consumers showing increasing preference for eco-friendly, sustainable, high-end fabrics, while value-led consumers are served via e-commerce and Modern Trade private labels.
- Geopolitical shifts and supply-chain adjustments are described as bolstering the 'Make in India' initiative and domestic manufacturing.
- Management states the outlook for the company's products appears good and expresses confidence in achieving improved operational performance.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Discipline over reinvention: holding customer relationships, running machinery-level energy-saving measures, and continuing to invest in property, plant and equipment even as margins narrowed.
- Strengthening Board independent oversight through re-appointment of Independent Directors.
- Operational efficiency and future readiness stated as the company's watchwords for the year ahead.
